examples.label: Edit a template PHP file (error.php) via the Templates panel
Trigger the webshell with a command

notes: Templates > Customise only exposes editable files for the active template - switch the active template if error.php isn't writable. Use a random GET-parameter name so the shell isn't trivially guessable.

recommended.note: Provides the admin login needed to edit a template.
Upgrade the webshell to a reverse shell.

name: Joomla - Template Editor Webshell (RCE)
description: With admin access, edit a template PHP file (e.g. error.php) via Templates > Customise to add a system() call, then invoke it for command execution.

defense.why_it_works: Joomla's template manager lets admin users edit PHP template files directly. Inserting system($_GET['cmd']); into error.php creates a webshell at the template's URL, executed by PHP on every request.
defense.prerequisites: Valid Joomla admin credentials. Template editing not disabled. Write permission for www-data on template files.
defense.impact: RCE as www-data. Full server access, database credential theft from configuration.php, and persistent backdoor.
defense.detection: Joomla audit log showing template file modification. File integrity alert on template PHP files. Web server log showing GET to template error.php with cmd parameter.
defense.artifacts: Joomla audit log (template file edit) | File system change: modified .php in /templates/ | Access log (GET /templates/protostar/error.php?<hash>=id)
defense.prevention: Restrict template editing via Joomla Global Config. Use filesystem restrictions so www-data cannot write template directories. Deploy file integrity monitoring.
defense.misconfiguration: Joomla template editor enabled. www-data has write access to /var/www/html/templates/. No file-change alerting.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Joomla -- template editing enabled by default
# /administrator/index.php?option=com_templates
# Templates editor: enabled for Super Users

# Filesystem -- /templates/ writable by web server
ls -la /var/www/html/templates/
# drwxrwxr-x www-data www-data templates/  <-- writable

# Any Super User can edit template PHP files directly
defense.secure_config:
# Joomla -- disable template file editing
# Global Configuration > System > Frontend Template Editing: No
# Global Configuration > System > Backend Template Editing: No

# Filesystem -- make templates read-only for web server
chown -R root:www-data /var/www/html/templates/
chmod -R 750 /var/www/html/templates/
find /var/www/html/templates/ -name '*.php' -exec chmod 640 {} \;

# PHP -- disable file write functions in php.ini
disable_functions = exec,passthru,shell_exec,system,file_put_contents,fwrite
defense.evasion: Edit a less-visited template file. Encode the PHP webshell with base64_decode to evade content scanners.
